coverage.assessment: Independent global and Chinese model and speech/product discovery, including IndiaAI, Qwen, image model repositories, robotics and international developer media. China and Japanese surface and multiple independent leads were physically checked. Some launch pages and regional claims remain unavailable.

Independently sampled global finance wires and investor/issuer releases, Chinese technology funding reporters and embodied deals; European environmental applications, read-source access and capital-versus-grant interpretation were investigated. Unreadable outlets or undocumented closing remain limits.

Inspected multiple primary lab feeds, date-indexed arXiv RSS and inventoried all returned Daily Papers entries; selected consequential available artifacts and explicitly kept publication-boundary research separate. Per-paper first public timestamp is often unavailable.

Independently followed public press, trade and regulatory announcements across China, UK, EU and Switzerland, including direct authority materials and separately timed public reporting. The visible federal press/standards indexes are a sample.

Reviewed vendor changelogs, official repository metadata, foundation releases, Japanese agent products and independent Show HN leads. Some account-specific announcements and projects could not be confirmed outside social and community sources. The same-link correction revisited the project-wide release chronology after finding a record limited to one exact tag. New repository, registry and independent searches support the stable CLI update and bound related workflow failures and distribution variants. The other issue topics retain their original review and limitations.

discovery.assessment: Discovery included multilingual general/sector sources, direct research and standards routes, funding bylines, launch databases, HN Show and cross-checks by the independent reviewer. Search results, direct links and relevant nested leads were preserved. Publisher subscriptions and holiday delays limit the evaluated sample. The scoped release correction adds independent bilingual and first-party distribution discovery. It does not retrospectively treat the new work as original collection.

findings.detail: Supplementary multilingual discovery and earlier-source checks brought material product, research and policy updates into the issue. The Nvidia Southeast Asia report, LINE roadmap, Dutch Meta hearing, WaterSense financing split and prior MiniMax lineup were independently dispositioned.
MoLT remains solely in the date-boundary bucket. Its documented submission and official arXiv RSS build lie on opposite sides of the opening cutoff.

Search, public source and publisher access remain sampled. Direct X, archive, paywalled and regional funding access were bounded. JEV, Laya and OSC remain unresolved, as does Microsoft CogACT2 checkpoint availability.

Reopened the full 466-candidate ledger and checked original scope and immutable provenance against the 459 signed records. No original candidate, query, source, or check was changed or removed. Candidate/article membership is 20 confirmed, one time-boundary item, 82 excluded and 363 pending.

The original window omitted stable Qwen Code v0.28.7 (2026-11-26T18:04:26Z). Independent multilingual discovery and direct GitHub release/REST, npm and PR checks separated the stable CLI release, precursor PRs, npm upload, earlier failed CI attempt and separate Desktop failure. The same-link correction adds the supported tool-limit and worktree changes, scopes the preserved per-turn cap, and uses chronology without the ambiguous same-calendar-day claim. The v0.28.6 entry remains independently supported.

Reviewed and dispositioned all six new adjacent leads: the earlier stable-workflow failure, a subsequent nightly, two SDK leads, the separate Desktop workflow failure, and a prior-day preview. A tool-specific REST open and a speculative SDK registry URL failed; a direct public GitHub REST response and official SDK release were available for the actual claims. The review is targeted to this correction. The original global search and publisher-access limits still apply.

article.limitations: Public discovery in Chinese, English, Japanese, French, Spanish, Korean and German. Search results, direct checks and independent review sample public channels rather than exhaust them. Holiday indexing, X 403, paywalls, inaccessible PR and paper publication hour uncertainty remain. JEV, Laya and OSC unconfirmed.
